name: Context, Activity, Episodic Memory & Workstream Operating Substrate
normative_scope: Privacy-governed capture coordination, context normalization, correlation, session/workstream projections, provenance enrichment, episodic retrieval and context composition over existing FA3 authorities without replacing their truth or execution ownership.
historical_truth_rule: FA3-JOURNAL-001 remains the sole canonical workstation event/history ledger; FA3 OS enrichment is carried inside or referenced from the Journal envelope and MUST NOT define a competing outer event envelope.
derived_projection_rule: Embeddings, summaries, inferred sessions/workstreams and semantic indexes are derived, rebuildable projections and MUST NOT rewrite or override canonical Journal history.

authority_boundaries.binary_artifact_truth: existing artifact Registry/BOM and approved project stores

session_resume.execution_rule: Resume Plan execution MUST be delegated to the canonical authority for each requested action.

invariants: The canonical workstation event envelope remains FA3-JOURNAL-CONTRACTS-001.
All persisted FA3 OS event enrichment is admitted through FA3-OS-POLICY-001 before durable storage.
Historical event payloads are never silently rewritten by semantic processing.
Derived projections are deletable and rebuildable from canonical permitted sources.
Every agent context retrieval is auditable and policy-filtered.
FA3 OS introduces zero new capabilities and zero new architectural authorities.
